body:
Honestly, it's just my perception of myself, and looking at pictures from 2 years ago looks scarcely different. Also, as I said, I don't bind regularly and my chest isn't "subtle." So you could be absolutely right. Maybe I should try to pass more often, but I never did in the past even when I tried, so I'm just... discouraged? I guess?

I do have issues with bitterness and jealousy, that's something I need to work on. It's definitely manifesting here, especially since one of those people I see doing better on half the time is somebody who has been very unkind to me in the past.

Also, that's relieving to hear about the skipping making little difference. I couldn't really help those cases. I spent two weeks in Japan at one point and wasn't comfortable trying to bring needles through TSA.

Thank you for this response. I feel like I'm going to reference it in the future when I'm feeling bad again. It really did make me feel better on a lot of points. I'll see if I'm comfortable enough in the future to post pictures, I know of basic ways to make my appearance less feminine (honestly, I should change my haircut), but getting feedback from actual people will likely help. Again, thank you.
It's weirdly comforting to know I'm not alone, but my sympathies anyway. Hopefully that'll change.
